# Independent audit: movable diagonal simplex depth

Audit of `candidate 44a12d13f3aabab3`.
Result: PASS, with no mathematical correction requested.

I checked the exact fiberwise barycentric swap and the displaced
candidate `s_i(t)`, including the residual term `u_i(r_p-r_j)`.
The touching majorant has the correct inequality direction because
`u_i<0`. Coordinatewise monotonicity of the positive-normal infimum
then gives the stated upper-segment equality and lower-segment
comparison. Vertical caps are handled by finite tilts that preserve
strict full and empty traces while reducing boundary traces; their
positive mixed boundary mass is not omitted.

The exact roof branch is

    w.X+a.(p-j) >= t+w_i[r_p-(d+1)t].

Its inverse continuous normal is `u_i=-w_i` and
`u_l=w_l-w_i` for `l!=i`, which is nonzero for every probability
normal `w`. Thus every branch is one genuine original ambient cap
after the volume-preserving source change of variables, including
`w_i=0`. Both directions of the exact infimum formula follow.
The distinguished coefficient `w_i` correctly remains attached to
the same normal; the formula does not optimize it separately.

For the compact-tilt argument, both the threshold and threshold minus
`r_p` are bounded by the stated `C`: the roof threshold is a convex
combination of `t` and `r_p-dt`. The replacement trace polyhedron is
nonempty and has zero lineality, because all source difference vectors
span the selected base space. It therefore has a vertex; independent
active rows with bounded right sides give exactly the uniform inverse
matrix bound. Newly attained empty supporting faces have zero
continuous volume, so trace replacement preserves every mass. The
compact branch objectives are continuous since their positive normal
never vanishes. This proves actual attainment and continuity.

The own-fiber maximum is attained by the independent uniform slab
Lipschitz bound. Coordinate permutations are actual symmetries of the
entire common-vertex source, so quasiconcavity legitimately reduces a
maximizer to the diagonal. The upper segment can then be replaced by
its centroid endpoint, while the zero endpoint has depth zero. This
proves the lower diagonal reduction without promoting a fiberwise
barycentric swap to an ambient symmetry. The exact own payment
`|T_d|(dt)^d` follows from the inscribed centroid simplex and the
matching common-vertex cap.

I also checked the interval counterexample's complementary cap masses,
its closed vertical directions, and the linked two-slope tilt formula.
They have the claimed orientations and signs. The orbit-floor note
is used only to distinguish a weaker normal-independent certificate.

Validation: `python3 supporting computation verify_movable_diagonal_simplex_roof_penalty.py`
passes the exact swap/roof, threshold, and interval checks.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
